calibration_basis: Tight KLU versus Sparse UGB differed by 0.057609Hz at 16.1007MHz; retain the predeclared 1e-5 waveform agreement scale and a 1Hz floor. This is a development transfer tolerance, not a new per-source noise estimate.
geometry_analysis: descriptive association only; area and wirelength are not circuit-objective predictions
post_PEX_proxy: 1/(2*pi*sum_R_ohm*sum_C_F), an unfitted one-pole frequency heuristic; not a calibrated circuit model or cheap fidelity
nominal_proxy: actual nominal-corner UGB used as an estimate of worst-corner UGB; requires nominal PEX/SPICE acquisition
